question: Should `ClawSegmentedControl` globally wrap every option set larger than four, or should wrapping remain specific to the Skill Workshop surface?
rationale: Both approaches fix the demonstrated truncation, but choosing a global threshold establishes a reusable Android design-system contract and can change height and geometry for other callers.

options.title: Approve Shared Wrapping
options.body: Adopt the four-per-row balanced wrapping rule after confirming no existing large caller depends on a single-row or fixed-height layout.

options.title: Scope To Skill Workshop
options.body: Keep the shared control single-row and apply a local multi-row layout only where the five filters currently truncate.

options.title: Pause For Design Revision
options.body: Leave the PR open until Android design ownership chooses another responsive pattern such as scrolling or adaptive sizing.

recommendation.title: Approve Shared Wrapping
recommendation.body: Adopt the four-per-row balanced wrapping rule after confirming no existing large caller depends on a single-row or fixed-height layout.
